steps.triad: A chord is several notes played together. The most common is the triad: three notes, skipping one white key between each. {c}, {e} and {g} make {cMajor}. Right hand: thumb, middle finger and little finger (1, 3 and 5).
steps.cChord: Play {cMajor} four times. Press the three keys together and lift them together.
steps.fAndG: Move the same hand shape and you get other major chords: {fMajor} starts on {f}, {gMajor} on {g}.
steps.cfg: Move the chord shape: {cMajor}, {fMajor}, {gMajor} and back to {cMajor}. Keep your hand in the same shape as it moves.
steps.cfgInTime: Now in time with the metronome, two beats per chord.
